subject: general
question: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath launched which book on public etiquette in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajal Neeti: Lok Vyavhaar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh**, **Yogi Adityanath**, officially launched the book titled **Rajal Neeti: Lok Vyavhaar** in **May 2025**.
 
• The book is authored by **Rajal Bandwar**, who is known for writing literature focused on **personal development**, **management**, and **ethical conduct**.
 
• The primary objective of **Rajal Neeti: Lok Vyavhaar** is to provide a comprehensive guide on **public etiquette** and the nuances of **social behavior** in both professional and personal spheres.
 
• During the launch event held in **Lucknow**, the **Chief Minister** emphasized that the book serves as an essential resource for cultivating **moral values** and improving **interpersonal communication** within society.
 
• The book **Rajal Neeti: Lok Vyavhaar** integrates traditional **Indian values** with modern-day **social requirements**, making it a relevant guide for the youth and public servants alike.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scope of the Book:**
 
 
• The term **Lok Vyavhaar** translates to **"Public Dealing"** or **"Social Interaction"**. It covers various aspects of **manners**, **body language**, and the **art of conversation**.
 
• The book **Rajal Neeti: Lok Vyavhaar** is part of a series by **Rajal Bandwar** that aims to simplify complex **management principles** for the common public.
 
 
 
• **Other Books in the Series:**
 
 
• **Rajal Neeti: Time Management**: This book focuses on **efficiency**, **productivity**, and the **optimal utilization of time** to achieve success in various walks of life.
 
• **Sanghatil Manavi Vyavasthapan**: This work deals with **human resource management** within **organizations**, emphasizing the **psychological** and **administrative** aspects of leading teams.
 
 
 
• **Government Focus on Literature:**
 
 
• The **Government of Uttar Pradesh** has frequently supported the publication of books that promote **social harmony** and **administrative excellence**.
 
• **Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** has been associated with several book launches, including those that document **cultural heritage** and **developmental milestones** of the state.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Theme of Public Etiquette:** The book addresses the growing need for **civility** in public discourse and provides practical tips on **conflict resolution** and **empathy**.
 
• **Significance for Youth:** The **Chief Minister** noted that the **Rajal Neeti** series is particularly beneficial for **students** and **competitive exam aspirants** to develop **soft skills** and a **disciplined lifestyle**.
 
• **The Divine Kumbh:** While **The Divine Kumbh** is another notable publication related to the state of **Uttar Pradesh**, it focuses on the **spiritual** and **cultural** significance of the **Kumbh Mela** rather than **public etiquette**.
 
• **Language and Accessibility:** The book is written in an accessible language to ensure that the message of **ethical living** and **refined conduct** reaches a wide audience across **India**.
</ul
